text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Each sprint focuses on building a small, working part of the product. This is called iterative development. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritised list called the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe what a user needs. Every day, the team holds a short meeting called a standup to share progress and solve problems quickly. Agile helps teams stay flexible and respond to change.
